notes.title: SUMMER SALE 66% OFF! & UPDATE #12
notes.content:
Endless Horde v2.5.12 is now online! 

Happy Summer sale! 
We bring you a small but no less important update. 

New features/Improvements

New Explosion VFX. We are experimenting on giving better vfx to the game. For now you can check out a new explosion vfx.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/4e20f7f9e574a7c21853cc62ca5c663d61005524.gif

Switching Minimap. You can now press TAB to change the position of the minimap.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/0dc7115db235574e8faf3d923586ce035ba36e19.gif

Top Players. The top players of the leaderboard are now displayed in the main menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/45c3c6e82785bb8e241312820b0945fa5043f7c3.jpg

Supply Boxes. Along with the scientists, a black box will spawn. If you repair it, it will automatically pickup the supply and experience pickups. There is one per spawn and can get destroyed by the zombies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/3cc8a01978d90b8af8b52b0999be916e89473e10.gif

 Balancing Changes Repair now only costs 100 supplies
    



Incoming New Stuff

Performance increase for the undead. Will cause less glitchy AI behavior.
Help about the boom button and its shortcut key being displayed at the pause menu.
Separating the "repair" into an extra slot so you don't have to equip it.


Words from the devs

Sorry for the lack of updates! as you all know, indie sales on steam are decreasing at an alarming rate. With less budget, less updates for long time released games. We are hoping to get a good injection of budget thanks to the summer sale and bring you cool stuff in the future. Meanwhile, if you see stuff dissapearing from the incoming list, its because it was cancelled.

Enjoy summer sale!


As always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update Coming Soon. Check out Zombie Desperation, 40% off!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

There will be an update soon that will incorporate one or two new features based in the feedback from the forums. But for now, we wanted to tell everyone to check out Zombie Desperation, another wallet friendly game. For a limited time 40% off, you can get it for....... $0.60!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/4f469a1c2ea5e7efd2425a0f0ef4ce360a75946e.gif

Just like Endless Horde, Zombie Desperation also has a leaderboard where the players have been struggling for the top spots. Can the Endless Horde community overtake them? Looking forward to see that. You can see a small video of the game down here. As you'll see, simple gameplay, gory horror fun, more than enough to pass some time or to keep you busy if you want a top spot in the leaderboard.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=it2C3D_MmHw
Wherever you are interested in the game or you just wish to support us with you 60¢ to help us keep making games, we will be really grateful for your purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/818570/Zombie_Desperation/

As always thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #11
notes.content:
Endless Horde v2.4 is now online! 

The facility has been overrun! push the red button! to destroy all enemies!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/0feae19166f2c839ef9bbfc1f0e2826b81a69af9.gif

New features/Improvements

Boom Button.  Destroys all enemies on the map. It has a cooldown of 3 seconds per enemy killed. Good to speed up during early waves and to get out of dangerous situations during late waves. Shortcut key: B
Balancing changes. The money generated per wave and exp per pickup has been increased to diminish grinding required to unlock units.
    



Incoming New Stuff

Performance increase for the undead. Will cause less glitchy AI behavior.
Survivors Log. In this section, the best players of the previous year will be displayed.
Help about the boom button and its shortcut key being displayed at the pause menu.


Words from the devs

The "invincible" undead bug was fixed weeks ago with a small patch.
We will be deleting a couple bug threads whose bugs have been fixed and so we will create a main bugs thread. Don't hesitate to post anything you find.
Join our new group! Once we gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. Join us!
As always, if you liked the game and would like us to keep updating it with new stuff. Don't hesitate to help us with a review to keep the game going.


And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #10
notes.content:
Endless Horde v2.2.4 is now online! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/b9c851b3f02f851024d0aca08bb7208e5418c841.gif

New features/Improvements

    Acid Barrels. Acid barrels have been placed in the map as part of the default map defenses
    Lifebars. Damaged undead will now have lifebards
    HP Range. The maximum and minimum hp of the undead in the map will now show up in the HUD.
    Balancing. Some weapons have been buffed so they are more useful with the current gameplay difficulty,
    Resolution. A different resolution algorithm has been implemented, hoping to widen the supported range of computers.
    Achievement Fixes. Fixed several bugs related to the achievements
    Splash screen. The splash screen has been removed. 
    Minor Changes. Fixed some typos and made several optimizations 
       here and there.
    



Incoming New Stuff

Optimizations to the undead, hoping to increase performance.
Survivors Log. In this section, the best players of the previous year will be displayed.

Words from the devs

With the new addition to the HUD and the help of the players we hope to fix the bug where the Undead gets super buffed.
Edit: The bug has been fixed. Will be mentioned in the next update.
Join our new group! Once gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. Join us!


And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SALE! 40% off and new update!
notes.content:
We hope you have a happy Halloween sale!

Endless Horde v2.2 is now online!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/dbf1d343cd2067fddd71233d49fec0eb7472bf80.gif

New features/Improvements

    Map Defenses. Turrets and some guards have been placed in the maps to help the player fend off the hordes during the early waves.
    Gameplay Tips. New gameplay tips were added to the loading screen 
    Difficulty Balancing. The HP of the zombies will now be increased every 3 waves. The more scientists dead, the more it will increase. The game will now be a bit harder.
    Fixed Props. Several tweaks to the props so they don't block the sight of the units
    SoundFix. Fixed the annoying bug where you could still hear sounds that were not on camera



Incoming stuff

More Map Defenses
New achievements.
New Units.


Words from the devs


We want to apologize for the late update and the delay of Deadly Escape's release. With hurricanes in the north and earthquakes in the south, some of our devs got affected. Nothing serious but enough to cause delays.
As always, if you liked the game, don't hesitate to write a review. We plan to update this game for a long long time, your reviews are always helpful.
Don't hesitate to post about any bug you may find! 


And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #7 - 40% off during Summer Sale and NEW MAPS!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/56578ebc01cd81af1daa7b46ecd3785bdbd84c77.jpg

New features/Improvements

    Two new maps. Based on the upcoming Deadly Escape, new maps are now playable. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/2f16fbf1739558f08b125c52807bd4cb4e7fb463.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28340092/37233cb6ae34f881c7261d0873baf941888267fe.jpg

You must have survived 50 waves(not in a row) to unlock both maps.

    Minimap Improvements. Units taking damage will now blink red. The units will remain red if they died.
    Run in background feature. The game can now run while minimized.
    Achievement fixes. 
    Resolution bug fix. See day one update. Also read the "words from the devs" for more info.
    Improved Nav. No more "Time stopping doors"
    Small bug fixes.


Incoming stuff

New achievements.
Gameplay Balancing. Some of the new updates have made the game too easy. 
Multi-Language support.
New Units.


Words from the devs


We wish you a happy summer sale shopping!
If you are enjoying the game, please consider writing a review. They help us maintain the game and our other projects.
With big changes, new bugs could appear, don't forget to post them at the forums so we can fix them!
If you are still experiencing the resolution bug, please post on this thread and we'll get in contact with you
We'll re-balance the game soon!
Apologies for the late update!




And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #5
notes.content:
New features/Improvements

    Placement Grid Update. The grid used to place units is now more accurate. Fixes several bugs like units overlapping.
    Skip Preparation Phase. During the preparation phase (GET READY), you can now click the counter for the wave to begin
    Volume Options Fix. The values of the music/SFX values have been fixed, the lowest volume possible will now be lower.
    Barrel Fixes. Fixed several bugs related to the barrels and also made them more efficient. 


Incoming stuff

Resolution bug fix. See day 1 update for more details
Multi-Language support
Two new maps
Difficulty changes. With the recent updates, the game might have become a bit too easy. We'll fix that soon.
Minimap Improvements Scientists under attack will turn red and blink


Words from the devs


We want to apologize for the delay in publishing this update.
Our second game is now on steam greenlight, check it out here, we appreciate your vote.

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #3
notes.content:
Endless Horde v1.0.3

New features/Improvements


    Steam Trading Cards
    Minimap Toggle with M, you can also click on it for the camera to 
                      move over that area.
    Speed up button. Once every undead has spawned during that wave, the speed up button will become available. It makes the undead become faster for that impatient, yet skillful player. Careful, could result in game over. Not recommended for early waves or lower level players.
    Increased EXP per wave
    Increased supplies spawn rate


Incoming Features

    Multi-Language support
    Improvements to the minimap

Bugs to be fixed

     Several other small bugs

It is time to start working on new content, don't hesitate to post your awesome ideas in the forums. 

If you have time to spare, please consider writing a review of Endless Horde.
It would greatly help us to maintain the game alive in the future!

Thanks!
